verdict.rationale: Navan documents that it can manage expenses and issue reimbursements, scan receipts for on-the-go expenses, and run approval workflows. Its API covers manual expenses, so the core submit-and-reimburse loop is a first-party capability. However, nothing in the evidence describes the payout method, timing, or employee-facing status tracking. Missing for 10: direct-deposit payout, reimbursement speed ("in days"), submission-to-payout status tracking for the employee, independent or hands-on corroboration.
